# Confirm edited saved entries use the selected recovery deadline

## What & Why
The selected recovery-window regression currently covers new answer and opportunity drafts. Editing an existing saved entry uses the same recovery notices but can regress independently, which could make a user's changes disappear earlier than the displayed deadline.

## Done looks like
- A browser test selects a non-default recovery window.
- Edits to an existing answer and opportunity are recoverable just before that deadline.
- Both edited drafts expire at the selected deadline and announce their loss.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
